audit.whatIsWrong: The published chart was wrong in six of seven rows. It gave Gangplank Level 1 at 7/10 and handed Irelia Level 3, Levels 4-5, First item and 2+ items, while the packet chart reads Irelia / Irelia / Skill / Skill / Gangplank / Gangplank / Skill.
audit.why: The page's own prose agrees with the packet, not with the chart: early says 'levels 1-3 are hers and you should play to lose them quietly', whys[2] says level 3 is where 'the lane stops being a free kill for her', whys[3] says 4-5 'keeps the lane neutral', whys[5] says the late edge goes to Gangplank 'that fits 51.98%', and whys[6] says it 'never tips far from even'. Three sources against the chart.
audit.corrected: Level 1 Gangplank 7/10 -> Irelia 4/10; Level 2 Skill -> Irelia; Level 3 and Levels 4-5 Irelia 4/10 -> Skill 5/10; First item Irelia 4/10 -> Gangplank 6/10; 2+ items Irelia 4/10 -> Skill 5/10. Level 6 already correct. Both layers, one atomic group.
sources: currentText early, whys[2], whys[3], whys[5], whys[6]

audit.whatIsWrong: The whole page times itself off 'Flawless Duet's cooldown' without ever stating it, and never mentions what changes at Irelia's 6.
audit.why: Flawless Duet is 16/14.5/13/11.5/10 — a real 13s window at rank 3 that you can count. Vanguard's Edge is 125/105/85 and leaves a blade wall behind, which is the actual level-6 change.
audit.corrected: 13s at rank 3 written into spikes[1] and mid; the R wall and what it does written into mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three errors. (1) The packet's defect line is right — not one of Irelia's abilities is named anywhere on the page. (2) Defiant Dance is called a 'shield' twice; Riot's text is a charged strike during which she takes reduced PHYSICAL damage — it is a directional damage-reduction window, not an absorb, and it only cuts physical. (3) early says 'her passive shred chunks your armour'; Ionian Fervor grants her stacking attack speed and bonus on-hit damage at max stacks — there is no armour shred in her kit at all.
audit.why: A player who believes she has a shield will try to burst through it; knowing it is physical-damage reduction while she charges tells them to trade before or after the charge instead. A player who believes their armour is being shredded will misbuild.
audit.corrected: Bladesurge, Defiant Dance, Flawless Duet, Vanguard's Edge and Ionian Fervor all named; the W corrected to physical-damage reduction during the charge in spikes[2]; the armour-shred claim replaced with what Ionian Fervor actually does in early.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer's itemization calls anti-heal core, but the content layer never says why Irelia heals.
audit.why: Bladesurge heals her on every cast and its cooldown refreshes off Marked or dying targets — in a big wave that is continuous sustain, which is exactly what Grievous Wounds is for.
audit.corrected: early now states that each Bladesurge reset heals her.

edits.before: Hold W for her two-blade E dash-stun, not her Q poke — cleansing the all-in and healing off missing HP keeps the lane neutral.
edits.after: Hold Remove Scurvy for Flawless Duet (E), not Bladesurge poke — cleansing the all-in and healing off missing HP keeps it neutral.

edits.before: She places her two E blades and dashes through for the stun to commit an all-in, but your W (Remove Scurvy) cleanses the stun on the spot and heals off missing HP, blanking the combo.
edits.after: She lands Flawless Duet (E) by converging both blades on you — 13s at rank 3 — but Remove Scurvy cleanses that stun on the spot and heals off missing HP, blanking the all-in.

edits.before: Your Sheen spike is the swing: empowered Parrrley detonating a chained Powder Keg out-bursts what her W shield can eat, so walk-up keg poke finally trades in your favour.
edits.after: Your Sheen spike is the swing: Defiant Dance (W) only cuts physical damage while she is charging it, so an empowered Parrrley into a chained keg beats that window.

edits.before: Land her two-blade E dash-stun while your W is on cooldown to lock in an all-in
edits.after: Converge both Flawless Duet (E) blades on you while your cleanse is down

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are hers and you should play to lose them quietly. Your Powder Kegs have a long cooldown and low HP, so if you drop one to poke she just walks up and free-hits the barrel dead, then Q-resets off the minion wave onto you while her passive shred chunks your armour. Don't try to fight here — you can't out-trade her sustained Q resets at level 1. Last-hit with Parrrley from max range, keep W up, and concede a little CS rather than feeding her an early kill and a reset snowball.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are hers and you should play to lose them quietly. Your Powder Keg has a long cooldown and low HP, so if you drop one to poke she walks up and free-hits it dead, then Bladesurge (Q) resets off the minion wave onto you — and each reset heals her. Ionian Fervor stacks attack speed off her spells, not armour shred. Don't fight here. Last-hit with Parrrley at max range, hold Remove Scurvy, and concede CS rather than feeding a kill and a reset snowball.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 stabilize as you get a second keg charge and can start Parrrley-into-keg poke when she steps up to farm. The key discipline: do NOT burn W (Remove Scurvy) on her Q poke — save it for her E. When she places her two blades and dashes through to stun and all-in, cleanse it with W and heal off your missing HP, and the whole combo evaporates. At 6 your Cannon Barrage adds zoning and dive threat but won't win the straight duel, so use it to cut her dash angles, not to brawl her head-on.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 stabilize as you get a second keg charge and can start Parrrley-into-keg poke when she steps up to farm. The key discipline: never burn Remove Scurvy on Bladesurge chip — save it for Flawless Duet (E), 13s at rank 3. Cleanse that stun, heal the missing HP, and the whole all-in evaporates. At 6 Vanguard's Edge (R) leaves a blade wall that damages and slows anything walking through it, so it cuts your retreat and you have no dash — hold Flash for the wall, not the damage.

notes: This chart was the worst in my slice — six of seven rows contradicted both the packet and the page's own prose, including handing Gangplank a 7/10 Level 1 in a matchup whose own 'early' paragraph says to play to lose levels 1-3 quietly. Fixed as one atomic group. Also corrected: Defiant Dance described as a shield (it is physical-damage reduction while charging), and Ionian Fervor described as armour shred (it is stacking attack speed plus bonus on-hit at max stacks). Neither of those is a naming nit — both change what you build and when you trade. I did not touch the full layer's 'Cleanse it with Q' lines in breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0] and report[5]: your cleanse is Remove Scurvy (W), not Q, so those three are wrong the same way, but they are part of the Flawless Duet focus chain and want rewriting together.
